title: Does an air shot count as a stroke?
question: If you swing at your ball on the tee and miss completely, does it count as a stroke?

choices.text: No, because you did not hit the ball.
Yes, it counts as a stroke.
You must re-tee your ball without penalty.
You can try again for free, but only once.

explanation: Whenever you make a swing at the ball with the intention of hitting it, even if you miss (an air shot), it counts as a stroke.

juniorVersion.title: If you swing and miss, does it count as a shot?
juniorVersion.question: You try to hit your ball from the tee, but you miss and don't touch it. Does that count as a shot?

choices.text: No, because you did not hit the ball.
Yes, it counts as a shot.
You must put your ball back on the tee and there's no penalty.
You can try again for free, but only once.

juniorVersion.explanation: If you swing at the ball and try to hit it but miss, it still counts as a shot. This is called an air shot.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: When you try to hit the ball but miss and do not touch it.
Another word for a shot. Every time you swing and mean to hit the ball, it counts as one stroke.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Let children try some swings where they purposely miss the ball so they learn what an air shot feels like and understand that it counts.
likelyMisconceptions: Some might think missing the ball does not count, but it does if you tried to hit it.
